We've got to find him before he hurts himself!|[[Wicket Wystri Warrick|Wicket]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] abandon their Honey Melon harvest to chase an entranced [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]]|<ref name="Ewoks 7">[[Ewoks (1985) 7|''Ewoks'' (1985) 7]]</ref>}}
'''Honey melon''' was a very sweet [[Melon/Legends|melon]] that grew on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. It could be used to enhance the flavor of other foods.
